spec.studio_prompt: A lush potted indoor palm plant in a modern minimalist ceramic planter. The planter is a smooth, bulbous rounded cylinder measuring 35 cm in diameter and 30 cm in height, made of glossy off-white ceramic (#CACACC) filled with rich, dark textured potting soil (#1E1813). Multiple slender cane stems rise upward to a total height of 100 cm, supporting dense, arching pinnate palm fronds with finely detailed, lanceolate leaflets in deep forest palm green (#283510) and olive undertones (#3B5319) with a delicate natural satin sheen.
